notes.title: ✨New Year, New Patch!✨
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy New Year!, adventurers!🎉

We’re releasing what will be [b]the final update for now[/b]. Over the past months, we’ve worked tirelessly since the game’s release—deploying patches and rolling out hotfixes as soon as you, the players, reported issues. Every negative review rooted in [b]technical[/b] or [b]design flaws[/b] has been [b]addressed and resolved[/b]. The game is now [b]very stable[/b], your feedback has been [b]heard and implemented[/b], and what’s left on our list is more about [b] fine-tuning[/b] than fixing disruptive problems.

But, for now, we won’t be able to release [b]more updates for the game[/b]. The team is focusing on [b]other projects[/b] that need our care and attention to help us grow and stay afloat in this wild world of game development. While we love that the game is free (and we know you do too), we’ve got to [b]keep the lights on[/b]! We hope you understand this decision.❤️ That said, new updates aren’t completely off the table. If the moment comes when the studio has the opportunity and stability to add new content to eWorlds, we’ll be sure to do so.

Moving on to the game update, this one is to [b]pre-mitigate[/b] bad experiences while unlocking achievements, and to give some interactables the in-game behaviour that was expected from them. 

The most important change is the fact that we removed the [b]2 player minimum[/b] in battle modes. Now you can[b] play solo[/b] and get Medals on Gamergy is Lava and Alienware Arena, or practice the Stages in Coliseum. This way, farming coins should be easier and you can discover a new aspect of the game, while not depending on a high Concurrent Players Count. We [b]strongly recommend[/b] playing these modes with a friend, though.

So let’s roll the full list:
[list]
[*] Reduced the minimum players for battle modes from 2 to 1.
[*] Gave Evil Tulips (purple shooting plants) a death trigger so you cannot just run through them.
[*] Adjusted Space HUB props so some World Portals are more easily visible.
[*] Adjusted a platforming section in Cave Trial to make the “Serpent Route” easier after obtaining the Loop.
[*] Visual Update to the Crane Model.
[*] Improved Remote Players real time synchronization.
[*] Adjusted some colliders in El Salvador’s rooftops.
[*] Interface SFX corrections.
[*] Increased the area where the Bomb SFX could be heard.
[*] Fixed some incorrect Sounds that could be heard while stepping on certain materials.
[*] Increased Scroll speed in the Store.
[*] Improved Coin materials and reflections on various maps.
[*] Adjusted lighting on Western Run.
[/list]
And… That’s all, folks! Before we go, we want to take a moment to say a [b]huge thank you[/b] to every single one of you. Your [b]support, feedback, and passion[/b] have meant the world to us. This game has been a journey we’ve shared together, and it wouldn’t be what it is today without this [b]incredible community[/b]. While this marks [b]the end of updates[/b], we’re so proud of what we’ve built and how you’ve embraced it. Please keep sharing your [b]adventures, memories, and love[/b] for the game—we’ll always treasure it. 💖

Thank you for being part of this world. See you around on our [url=https://discord.gg/aGYfh7KT7m][b]Official eWorlds Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2513440/discussions/][b]Steam Discussions[/b][/url]. You’re the best!

The [b]GGTech Studios[/b] Team. ❤️[/h3]

notes.title: Single Player Mode, avoiding Motion Sickness and a lot of little fixes!🔧
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Adventurers!🚀

This week we bring you a new patch which adds some features the[b] community requested[/b], plus [b]fixes[/b] and [b]improvements[/b] as usual. 

But before, we wanted to apologize for the Technical issues early this week. We received a lot of traffic (thank you for playing by the way) and our server provider blocked incoming requests, so many of you may have run into “Server under maintenance” message. Also, we found some players accessing eWorlds from and outdated launcher inside Steam, and this caused many players to be unable to use portals, get Loops, or even just Spawn in their desired Worlds. For this reason we include now a "Version check" when launching eWorlds, so this should be fixed already but if you do find this message anytime please let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/aGYfh7KT7m][b]Discord[/b][/url].

[b]Now, for the patch notes![/b]

[b]VSYNC Setting[/b]
[hr][/hr]For starters, we’ve tried to address the motion Sickness some of you have reported, as it makes the experience really poor to players who suffer from it.
To tackle that, we already offer the possibility to adjust [b]Field of View[/b] (FOV) in settings, and in this patch we’ve added a Setting to[b] disable VSYNC[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/db07ffe5fc78d535111dad0eaae0e3682635fbe1.png[/img]

If these still don’t work for you, we’ll let you know we are working right now on a setting to offer FPS limits at various ranges, as inconsistent or too high FPS can also result in motion sickness for some players. This will come in the next patch!

[b]Single Payer Mode[/b][hr][/hr]We’ve seen some players struggle when other, more experienced players griefed them with the Hammer, or distracted them in various ways, as in the end, eWorlds is a Multiplayer Online Game. Although it goes “against” eWorlds initial design, we now offer the possibility to play without seeing or interacting with other players. 
Just go to [b]Settings[/b], check “[b]Single Player Mode[/b]” and the game will create a [b]private Lobby[/b] for you.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/91e07ceb3dd11620f7cc33872333e71e6601ca01.png[/img]

At the moment you cannot join friends in private Lobbies but this setting will allow you to play at your own pace, to just complete the game… Or to set new Best Times in your favourite Time Trials. Thanks to a dedicated [b]community member[/b] (❤️) eWorlds now has an entry on [url=https://www.speedrun.com/eWorlds/forums][b]Speedrun.com[/b][/url], so if you are motivated to beat the best times, head there, and share your gameplay!

[b]Coliseum Battle system off[/b][hr][/hr]Before, you were forced to jump into battle while there were at least 2 players in the room, and this could be frustrating for players trying to complete the 5 Loops. Now, players who want to battle will need to [b]stay inside the “Battle Ready Area”[/b], and only they will be teleported to the Arenas, leaving “[b]non-competitive players[/b]” out so they can search for Loops. 

[b]Non-PVP Areas Setting[/b][hr][/hr]And, for all of you who love a real challenge, you now can select an option to [b]Disable “Non-PVP Areas”[/b]. This way, the Platforming Sections that deactivate PVP by default won’t have an effect on players who activate this option, so they can [b]fight each other[/b] on every corner of eWorlds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/093163f4892a68ceac36bab5e1651b60a303edcc.png[/img]

[u]In this Platforming Sections[/u], players with the Non-PVP Areas [b]''Deactivated''[/b] will have their name in [b]red[/b], and will be able to use violence against other players in red, while players with the Setting [b]"Activated"[/b] will be affected normally by them and be invulnerable to other players powerups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/fe85f4b632f62f349392ddd14adf830ef5f8458b.png[/img]

With these points out of the way, here you have the [b]full list of fixes[/b] for today’s update:
[list]
[*] Added VSYNC toggle to settings.
[*] Added Single Player Mode.
[*] Now, Coliseum does not take you into the Battle zone while you stay out of the battle ready Area.
[*] Added "Non PvP Areas" Toggle to settings.. 
[*] Reworked Platforming Section on Space HUB to make recovery easier. 
[*] Now, when launching eWorlds for the first time, the game should automatically select your native Steam Language. Still you can change the Language from Settings. 
[*] Reduced greatly the Grappling Hook cooldown so you can use it again faster after shooting it. 
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC dialogues would appear without their names. 
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow to close the chat pressing ESC.
[*] Fixed a bug where you didn't get the Silver Rafa skin after Obtaining the Golden Loop.
[*] Adjusted the position of many props and shadows that were slightly off. 
[*] Adjusted round times in Battle modes so now there is less time between rounds.
[*]Now you can see in which worlds you can find each Powerup by opening the Progression Map on Space HUB.
[*]Now you can access the Tutorial again from the Settings Menu by pressing F1 or Select.
[*] Now, when you Start eWorlds, it will check if your version is up to date. If it is not, a pop-up will tell you to update the game.
[/list]

We hope you like these fixes, as we are working hard on improving eWorlds after its release to please as many of you as possible and overall make a better game. [b]Thank you for playing[/b], see you around!✨[/h3]

[h3]If you experience any issues, contact us via [url=https://discord.gg/aGYfh7KT7m][b]Official eWorlds discord[/b][/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2513440/discussions/][b]Steam Discussions[/b][/url] or if you have any other feedback you can use this [url=https://forms.gle/pV9GWDeE418qrKuh6][b]Feedback Form[/b][/url].

notes.title: New Content and Release Date!✨
notes.notes:
[h3] Attention, adventurers! 🚀

As we told you a few weeks ago, we have been working on very important changes for eWorlds, giving a new approach to the game and focusing on a more compact and polished experience.

Today, we want to share with you all the details of this update, which will be available at the launch of eWorlds... 

[h2]October 25th!🎉[/h2]

[b]🎮 A tribute to collectathons fans[/b]

If you love classic, [b]collectathon-style platform games[/b], you're in luck. We've worked on creating a little love letter to those games that marked an era, and best of all, you'll be able to enjoy it both alone and in company. Our goal is to transport you back to those memories and offer an experience that makes you relive the excitement of those titles.


[b]🏆 The Quest for the Golden Loop [/b]

Get ready to embark on a quest to find the [b]Golden Loop[/b], a legendary artifact full of mystery and power. After an accident leaves your ship stranded in the [b]Lost World[/b], you'll need to [b]collect Loops [/b]to unlock access to the [b]Space HUB[/b] and explore unique worlds. Each Loop you gather will not only bring you closer to the [b]Golden Loop[/b], but will also reveal more about the vast universe around you!

[b]🌍 New Worlds to Explore[/b]

Get ready to discover [b]new worlds[/b], such as the [b]Space HUB[/b] and its super high climb, [b]Western Bandits[/b], where you'll have to dodge Wild West bandits, and the terrifyingly fun [b]Manor Island[/b]. In addition, we have improved all existing maps, adding more [b]playable and exciting content[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/8cf0ce901afdcb75136ab6b6d83db79ada60e25b.gif[/img]

[b]🛠️ New mechanics[/b]

The [b]Power-Ups[/b] you knew have evolved: now you can use the [b]Hammer[/b] to [b]stun[/b] other players and the [b]Bomb[/b] to [b]push[/b] them, adding an extra dose of fun to PvP challenges. You will also be able to use the [b]Grappling Hook[/b] to [b]defeat the Aliens[/b] that invade different areas of the worlds - beware!
We have added a new [b]secondary action[/b], which will allow you to [b]spin in the air[/b] and reach further. And if you [b]combine it with the Umbrella[/b]... How far do you think you'll be able to go?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/718c22c490e98ff66a697479a2e6ef26a6cfabd7.gif[/img]

[b]🖥️ Interfaces Rework[/b]

Not only have we improved the gameplay content, but we've also completely overhauled the[b] 2D visual aspect[/b] of the game! We’ve completely redesigned the [b]HUD and menus[/b] to make the experience smoother, more intuitive, and visually appealing.

Now, navigating through the menus and tracking your progress will be easier than ever, and the new visual design will immerse you even further into the universe. We want every moment in the game, from gameplay to menu navigation, to be as enjoyable as it is fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/c9d3df26100681c90b4327bb207762ff62546736.png[/img]

[b]🎮 A Game for Everyone[/b]

At eWorlds, our goal is simple: to create a place where everyone can have fun. We don't have any big pretensions, we just want you to have a great time, whether you're playing alone or with friends.💜 And remember, the game is [b]totally free[/b]!✨

So, [b]get ready for a new eWorlds experience[/b]! We can't wait for you to try it out. Your feedback has been crucial, and we are here to keep improving and creating unforgettable moments together.💞

Thank you for being part of our community and for joining us on this adventure!🌟[/h3]

[h1]Steam page update 🎮[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Have you visited our Steam Page yet? We’ve updated it with [b]new images, game renders and spectacular GIFs[/b]! And, on top of that, very soon we will be able to share with you the [b]new trailer[/b] we are working on…

[h1]Online Play upgrades 📡[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
We are still adding features and improving our online game system: Now your [b]emotes [/b]will be seen by other players, so you will be able to cheer them when they complete a mission they are stuck on… Or you could [b]mock them[/b] after you best them in battle mode  😈 

On top of that, our interactive world events are shared between players! If you need help to unlock a specially hard-to-get Loop, or it’s hard for you to get across a map fast enough after pressing a button, your friends can press it for you to get the prize! This sets the ground for [b]new Co-op puzzles and team game maps[/b] so stay tuned to our newsletter…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/1622f45e4a0b4dd38a474fe19a3d9325334cf29a.gif[/img]


[h1]New Maps! 🗺️[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
And, of course, [b]eWorlds keeps growing[/b], and so do the number of maps available to play!


Today we bring you[b] Train Time Trial[/b]: a crazy race against time in the cars of a moving train, which you will need to beat as quickly as possible while dodging[b] Lasers, Turrets, and Shocking Ground Tiles![/b]

[table noborder=1  equalcells=1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/dc467e8a879d4ea7516a950788f906d3dd902a8b.png[/img]

Last but not least: Two levels that have cleared the sketching stage, [b]Lost World Hub[/b] and [b]Western Renegades.[/b]

[b]Lost World Hub[/b] will be a slightly bigger map filled with [b]puzzles[/b],[b] trade missions [/b]and [b]portals [/b]to reach [b]new maps and activities[/b]. 
[b]Western Renegades[/b] will be an [b]Adventure [/b]type map where you will have to [b]explore [/b]and [b]platform around[/b] to clear every mission, while you dodge enemy Renegades in our new [b]Stealth puzzles.[/b] 

[h1]eWorlds: Did you know? ❓[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Did you know that eWorlds started being a game with[b] Isometric cameras[/b]?

Before getting to work on eWorlds as we know it today, we were working on other formats, also well focused around the Social and multiplayer aspect , but with a different view of the gameplay, much more 2D-like.

[list]

[*] Review of the launch.
[*] eWorlds in GAMERGY 2023.
[*] Upcoming news.
